hero.subtitle: Capture or select a photo. Get a complete original song with vocals, lyrics, and custom cover art — in minutes. No musical experience needed.
showcase.label: Real Results
showcase.title: Every photo becomes a song
showcase.subtitle: A sunset, a car in a garage, friends on a jet ski — each photo inspires unique lyrics, melody, and vocals. Press play to hear real songs generated by the app.
howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.title: Pick a photo. That's it.
howItWorks.step1.title: Choose a Photo
howItWorks.step1.text: Snap a new photo or pick one from your library. A sunset, your pet, a concert — any moment works. That's the only required step.
howItWorks.step2.title: Add Context (Optional)
howItWorks.step2.text: Want more control? Add keywords to guide the AI — a name, a feeling, a memory. The song becomes even more personal and accurate.
howItWorks.step3.title: Listen & Share
howItWorks.step3.text: Your unique song with original lyrics and vocals is ready in minutes. Play it, read the lyrics, and share it anywhere.
features.label: Features
features.title: More than you'd expect
features.twoVersions.title: Two Versions Per Song
features.twoVersions.text: Every photo generates two unique song versions — different styles, different vibes. Pick your favorite or keep both.
features.smartSuggestions.title: Smart Suggestions
features.smartSuggestions.text: The app learns your style over time. It suggests fresh ideas, detects repetitive patterns, and recommends new genres — all privately on your device, powered by Apple Intelligence.
features.liveActivity.title: Live Activity & Dynamic Island
features.liveActivity.text: Watch your song being created in real-time on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. You'll know exactly when it's ready.
features.widgets.title: Home Screen Widgets
features.widgets.text: Your latest songs and generation status live right on your Home Screen. Quick access without opening the app.
features.siri.title: Siri & Shortcuts
features.siri.text: "Hey Siri, create a song." Full Shortcuts integration for hands-free music creation from any photo.
features.languages.title: 5 Languages
features.languages.text: Songs and lyrics generated in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, and German — auto-detected from your device language.
features.platforms.title: iPhone, iPad & Mac
features.platforms.text: Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Apple Silicon. Your songs everywhere you go.
features.liquidGlass.title: Liquid Glass Design
features.liquidGlass.text: Designed with the iOS 26 Liquid Glass visual language. Translucent materials, fluid animations, and depth throughout every screen.
features.visionPro.title: Apple Vision Pro
features.visionPro.desc: A spatial experience for creating and listening to your songs in an entirely new dimension. SnapSong reimagined for Apple Vision Pro.
features.interactiveWidgets.title: Interactive Widgets
features.interactiveWidgets.desc: Compact widgets that live right between your app icons. Start a new song or play your latest creation with a single tap — without ever opening the app.
useCases.label: Made For
useCases.title: Songs for every moment
useCases.travel.title: Travel Memories
useCases.travel.text: Turn your travel photos into musical memories you'll want to replay forever.
useCases.gifts.title: Unique Gifts
useCases.gifts.text: Create personalized songs for friends and family. A photo of them becomes their song.
useCases.creators.title: Content Creators
useCases.creators.text: Original, royalty-free music from your own photos. Perfect for videos, reels, and stories.
useCases.everyday.title: Everyday Moments
useCases.everyday.text: Your pet, your coffee, your backyard. Even the simplest photos make surprisingly great songs.
trust.privacy.title: Privacy First
trust.privacy.text: All data collected is not linked to your identity. Songs, photos, and personal data are stored locally on your device. Apple Intelligence features run entirely on-device — nothing is sent to the cloud.
trust.accessibility.title: Accessible to Everyone
trust.accessibility.text: Built to be usable by everyone, from day one. Not as an afterthought — as a foundation.
madeBy.text: Built by Henrique Velloso — indie developer from Brazil, 3× WWDC Scholar, and Apple Developer Academy alumnus. Building apps for Apple platforms for over a decade.
finalCta.title.line2: You just haven't heard it yet.
finalCta.subtitle: Download SnapSong and turn any moment into music.
